answer: Every new identity must take a $5 microloan and repay it over 30 days of service before earning or voting; default blacklists it and its sponsor. Loans sit on a ridge of tamper-proof entries any agent can wander through to verify. Repaid loans shine like an oasis; defaults stay visible. Faking one identity costs $5 plus interest, so 100 fakes cost $500 - linear scaling.
